name: AML Watcher
summary: Anti-money-laundering screening for sanctions, PEP and adverse media through a dashboard or API, with ongoing monitoring and a free trial.
best_for: fintechs, payment firms and compliance teams that need sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening through a dashboard or an API, from a small volume upward
skip_if: you want a published flat monthly price, a self-serve cancel button, or you screen so little that a set-up cost of $250 or more is not worth it
honest_knock: The recurring price is only visible after you set the search volume in the calculator, so we cannot give a monthly number. There is a one-time set-up cost on Basic and Premium, unused credits do not roll over, extra searches are billed at the end of the cycle, and cancelling means emailing sales.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-07 on amlwatcher.com/pricing) AML Watcher sells anti-money-laundering screening in three plans: Basic for quick checks, Premium for in-depth risk analysis and enhanced due diligence, and Enterprise for large organizations. The monthly or yearly amount is calculated by a slider for searches per month and entities monitored, and the page text we read does not show those amounts, so we do not quote a plan price. What the page does show is a one-time set-up cost of $250 for Basic and $1,000 for Premium, with Enterprise on a custom quote, and a saving of 17% for yearly billing. The minimum plan includes 100 monitored entities. A free trial gives the first five searches free. Extra searches above a package are charged at the end of the billing cycle at your agreed per-unit rate, unused credits do not roll over, and screening plus monitoring the same customer counts as one monitored entity in a month. Cancellation is done by emailing the sales team, and access continues to the end of the billing cycle.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session reached the plans page of AML Watcher after the account was created and the e-mail verified, and stopped there: a compulsory window Payment Setup with a card field covered the whole page and Escape did not close it. The window offered 25 free AML screening searches for adding a card, where the dossier said the first five searches are free with no mention of a card; this is a change at the vendor, recorded as an update dated 18 Nov 2026. Nothing was entered, so no search was run. The plans page behind the window showed Basic and Plus at Starts at $0/yr, with the price only after entities are chosen on a slider, and Enterprise through Contact Sales. Account and start: we created the account and our AI assistant looked at the app in our browser on 18 November 2026; the interface was in English. The dossier name is AML Watcher and the review is on OSM (osm/aml-watcher-review.html); the dossier domain is amlwatcher.com and app.amlwatcher.com is the same developer. The page opened was app.amlwatcher.com/plans. No search was run. What the app showed: a compulsory window Welcome to AML Watcher with Payment Setup lay over the whole page. The only other control was Logout, and Escape did not close the window. Its text: Complete Your Setup: Account Created Successfully, Email Verified, Ready for Card Setup; FREE BONUS. Get 25 Free AML Screening Searches. Add your card today and instantly receive 25 free AML screening searches to get started with your compliance journey. The fields were Card Information and Cardholder name, with a tick box for the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy and the button Add Card & Continue. Nothing was entered. So the free searches cannot be reached in the app without a card. The dossier says the first five searches are free, without a mention of a card; the app now offers 25 free searches against adding a card. This is a change at the vendor, recorded as an update dated 18 Nov 2026, not as a correction of the dossier. The core function, a screening search with its time, match scores and false positives, was therefore not tested. Plans on the page behind the window, only read: the slider What is the volume of search entities you need? stood at 0 (range 0 to 5000), with a monthly and yearly invoice switch and Save 17%. Basic: Essential data for personal and medium business, Starts at $0/yr, Select entities to get started; PEP, sanctions, watchlist and adverse media screening, ongoing AML monitoring, a dashboard, an API (1/second) and one team member. Plus (MOST POPULAR): Perfect for Compliance officers and medium businesses, Starts at $0/yr, Select entities to get started; everything in Basic plus alias, relatives and close associates, biometric screening, bulk screening (25), adverse media ongoing monitoring, a customizable risk engine, up to 5 whitelist and blocklist entries, Upto 3 search limits and three team members. Enterprise: Let's Talk, CONTACT SALES; bulk screening (50), unlimited whitelist, blocklist and search limits, an API of 5/sec and team members on request. The prices only show after a number of entities is chosen; none was chosen. Screenshots: none were kept, because the screen showed our e-mail address and name; there is no image to check or mask. Cancelling: not applicable, because no card was added and no plan was started. Not tested: searches, times, match scores and false positives, a demo or business e-mail address, and cancelling, because of the card requirement. Clean up: no test data was created; the account stays; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A compulsory window with a card field lay over the whole app and Escape did not close it, and the only other control was Logout. The free searches are offered only against adding a card. The plans show Starts at $0/yr and no price until a number of entities is chosen.
